newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Diagnostics sees lower Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Diagnostics sees lower Q2 net.

text.p: Meridian Diagnostics Inc said Monday it expects fiscal second quarter net earnings of about $1.13 million, down from $1.35 million a year earlier.
It said it expects net sales of about $8.34 million, up $1.08 million, or 15 percent, from a year ago.

Based on about 109,000 more weighted average common shares outstanding during the fiscal 1997 second quarter, ended March 31, earnings per share are expected to fall to about $0.08 from $0.10 a year earlier, Meridian Diagnostics said.
Analysts had predicted second quarter earnings per share of $0.12, according to First Call.
